title: Run probability after halting
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine and $C$ an initial configuration. Suppose every choice word of length $T$ leads to a halted configuration, and let $T\le T'$. For any decidable configuration property $Q$, the probability that $Q$ holds after a uniformly chosen length-$T'$ run from $C$ equals the probability for a uniformly chosen length-$T$ run from $C$.
hypotheses_covered: Every length-$T$ choice word leads to a halted configuration
